_comment: Minimal schemas enforced by gates/run_gates.py (G0). Deliberately dependency-free: a tiny validator in run_gates.py reads this, so no jsonschema install is needed. Types: str, int, float, bool, list, dict, enum:<a|b|c>, list[str].

source._desc: One externally-verifiable finding. The unit that G1 checks.
_rules: quote must be a verbatim span from url, >= 20 chars - G1 fetches and string-matches it
no claim without a url; 'commonly known' is not a source

TWO-AXIS SOURCE MODEL (2026-09-13). vividness and attestation are INDEPENDENT. A Reddit or Stack Overflow thread is routinely high-vividness and firsthand_anonymous: excellent for world texture, worthless as evidence that something is common.
vividness=high requires rebuildable specifics: error strings, tool+version, table/column names, timings, org context. 'A pipeline broke' is low no matter how long the quote is.
usable_for entries must be a subset of [world_texture, mechanism, frequency].

frequency REQUIRES attestation in {firsthand_named, secondhand} AND source_type not in {forum, vendor_page}. An anonymous forum post can never license a frequency claim - this is the rule the 47% citation-audit failure would have caught.
vendor_marketing sources may carry usable_for=[world_texture] only (F400: claim E8's three 'independent' sources collapsed to one seller-side anchor).

claim._desc: An assertion the swarm is making, with provenance and attack history.
_rules: evidence entries must be ids that exist in state/knowledge/
status=verified requires >= 1 evidence id and >= 2 attack ids

tool._desc: A data application or a candidate mock/connector for one.
_rules: replication_strategy=drop means v1 does not build this surface at all - record why (no archetype demand, or licence/cost)
replication_strategy=custom_mock_required must state, in notes or fidelity_gap, how many endpoints/objects a real TASK needs - not how many the product has
repo_url present means G2 fetches license/liveness from the GitHub API
replication_ease=easy requires probe_result=pass
AGPL or source-available license is an automatic G2 failure

failure._desc: A landed attack. Recorded so a later round does not rediscover it.
_rules: target must resolve to a real artifact id - G4 checks this
the failure id must appear in its target's attacks: list - G4 checks both directions
also_applies_to lets one attack scope itself to sibling artifacts; G4 links those too

archetype._desc: A high-level task archetype. The RQ2 deliverable.
_rules: derived_from must cite source ids from state/knowledge/ - archetypes are derived, never invented
grading must name a concrete check, not 'LLM judge decides'
human_hours below 2 is a G3 warning: the meeting specified tens of hours

agent_visible_brief is the ONLY text the agent sees. description/why_hard/failure_modes_expected are AUTHOR-SIDE and routinely name the planted defects - shipping them as the brief hands over the answer (F202). Every archetype needs this field before it ships.
status=derived requires at least one attack record from each of R1, R2 and R3. An archetype nobody has attacked is a draft, not a deliverable.

COMPOUND ARCHETYPES (R002). composed_of names the archetypes intertwined; interaction_mechanism names HOW they interact. Two unrelated bugs in one world is not a compound - if the agent can solve them independently in either order, it is added length, not added difficulty. A compound must carry at least one deterministic check that cannot pass unless BOTH defects were found.
